name: Long Put into Earnings
summary: Buy a put ahead of an earnings report. Same structural flaw as the call version - IV crush usually exceeds the realised move. Marked a bad idea.

legs.dte_rule: first expiry after the report, 2-9 DTE

max_profit: Large on a gap-down beyond the implied move
max_loss: Debit x 100; base case is a substantial loss to IV crush even when direction is right
breakevens: strike - debit, which must be compared against the implied expected move

greeks.vega: positive and toxic - bought at peak event IV

when_to_use: Marginally more defensible than the call version because downside gaps are fatter-tailed and skew can steepen further, but still a losing proposition on average. Disabled by default.
entry_rules: Gate: front-expiry IV below the median of the last 8 earnings cycles
Implied expected move = 0.85 x ATM straddle; your downside target must exceed it
Debit <= 0.3% of equity; max 2 per quarter
DISABLED by default; requires explicit per-trade human enable
management_rules: Exit within 30 minutes of the post-report open
Take profit at +75%; stop at -50% or at the 30-minute mark
exit_rules: Sell to close by 10:00 ET the session after the report
15:30 ET expiry-day flatten; an ITM put auto-exercises into short stock
assignment_risk: None (long); auto-exercise into short shares is the hazard.
liquidity_needs: Spreads blow out post-report; verify normalisation before exiting.
common_mistakes: Buying the weekly at peak IV the afternoon before the report and losing despite a correct directional call.
